headline: Weather is slowing Newark and Dulles; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: Newark has low visibility and rain, enough to slow arrivals and departures.
Washington Dulles has very low clouds and rain, enough to slow arrivals and departures significantly.
Across the seven hubs reporting, at least 85% of flights are on time (within 30 minutes of schedule), so the rest of the operation is running normally.
124 United flights are in the air, 34% fewer than the usual 187 for this time of day, and United schedules far fewer flights than usual for Thanksgiving Day.
